summary: Checked the fix for the Netlify white screen (t.map is not a function). I served a production build made without REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL on localhost:5055 using serve -s, which sends index.html for every route the same way Netlify's SPA redirect does. /, /shop, /faq, /product/anything and /cart all showed the navbar, footer and page headings. There were 0 uncaught page errors. The only console.error was the expected 'REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is not set' message. /product/anything falls back to the Shop page with 0 pieces. Nothing regressed on the preview site: home shows 5 categories and 8 Her Favourites cards, /shop shows '9 PIECES', the product page opens, Add to bag raises the cart count from empty to 1, /faq lists FAQs, and admin login reaches /admin with the Products tab showing 9 rows. netlify.toml parses as valid TOML with base=frontend, command='yarn build', publish='build' and a /* -> /index.html 200 redirect. frontend/public/_redirects exists and was copied into the build.
action_items: The user must set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in Netlify's environment variables and run a new deploy so the built bundle contains it. The fix only stops the crash: without the variable the live site renders with no products. The backend must also allow the Netlify origin in CORS.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js: the response interceptor rejects any response whose content-type is not JSON. Backend endpoints currently return only JSON (no 204, file or stream responses found), so nothing breaks today, but a future 204 or file-download endpoint would be wrongly rejected. Consider letting 204 responses and requests that set responseType through.

If the env var is missing, API is the string 'undefined/api' and requests go to a relative path. That is harmless now because of the interceptor, but failing fast or showing a visible banner would make the problem easier to spot.
seed_data_creation: None. The only change was one item added to the cart in browser localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: A build without REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is at /app/frontend/build and served on localhost:5055 (npx serve -s build -l 5055). Its bundle has no preview URL in it. Useful testids: nav-cart, pdp-add-to-cart, faq-list, faq-q-N, admin-email, admin-password, admin-login-submit, tab-products, product-card-<slug>, category-<name>.
rca of the issue: frontend/.env is gitignored, so the Netlify build got an undefined REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Requests then went to 'undefined/api/...' on the Netlify site, the SPA redirect answered with index.html as a string, and .map() on that string crashed the React tree. Mitigation: the interceptor rejects non-JSON responses, so components fall back to their empty state; a console.error warns about the missing variable; netlify.toml, _redirects and DEPLOYMENT.md were added. Customer case reproduced locally with a no-env build plus serve -s; the crash no longer happens. I could not test the actual Netlify deployment.
